task: What is NEXUS Creative HQ (nexuscreativehq.com) in London? What services does it offer, who runs it, what partnerships does it have in China, and what is its relationship to UK Endorsing Services and the Innovator Founder visa?

result.json_content: {"result":"NEXUS Creative HQ presents itself as a founder-support and business-building platform for creative, digital, tech and ESG-aligned ventures. Its stated services include incubation, business concierge support, programmes, founder education and networking, and visa-endorsement services. Companies House lists NEXUS CREATIVE HQ LIMITED at a Croydon registered address; the passages do not establish a London office address. Danyi Chen appears in a founder spotlight, but the passages do not confirm who runs the organisation. On China, NEXUS says it connects businesses, incubators, science parks and scale-ups across borders, with China its flagship corridor; another “About NEXUS” snippet says the group’s first main headquarters was founded in Tianjin in 2009. No specific China partnership is identified. NEXUS describes offering visa-endorsement services, while UK Endorsing Services (UKES) describes its own Innovator Founder endorsement for people establishing an innovative, viable and scalable UK business. The passages do not establish a formal relationship between NEXUS and UKES, or show that NEXUS itself is an authorised endorsing body."}
